selection_rule: Choose the most specific active condition; missing_data blocks KPI claims for affected scope.

new_input.when: A new valid input fingerprint is detected.
new_input.objective: Validate, calculate and draft the first sourced management view.
new_input.stop_condition: Required data or mapping is missing.

changed_input.objective: Recalculate and explain only traceable changes versus the prior accepted run.
changed_input.stop_condition: The changed scope cannot be reconciled.

missing_data.when: A required dataset, field, period, currency, sign rule or material mapping is absent or ambiguous.
missing_data.objective: Prevent unsupported KPI claims and request the smallest exact correction.
missing_data.safe_retry: Re-run after the named file, field or mapping is supplied and validated.
missing_data.stop_condition: Do not calculate the affected KPI until validation passes.

recovery.objective: Retry safely without changing inputs or rules.
recovery.safe_retry: Use the same source fingerprint and deterministic configuration.

pending_approval.when: An external action awaits human approval.
pending_approval.objective: Present the exact draft, sources and intended recipient without sending.
pending_approval.stop_condition: No external action before explicit approval.

periodic_review.when: The configured review interval is due without a more specific signal.
periodic_review.objective: Review data freshness, open issues and KPI relevance.
periodic_review.stop_condition: Do not restate unchanged results as new findings.
